pages.quiz:
MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

4. Best practice when working on Songs PERFORMING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs PERFORMING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs PERFORMING.
   C. Practise Songs PERFORMING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Songs PERFORMING.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

6. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   C. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Dance.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

10. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Songs PERFORMING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Singing games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. C — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. A — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Practise Songs PERFORMING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

6. C — Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — The speed of the music

8. D — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — Red, blue, and yellow

10. A — Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Musical Instruments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
